propositions: The mcp compose service has no mechanism to provision or mount a ticket store, resulting in empty list_tickets responses and ticket_not_found errors on deployed instances.
The ticket store directory .tickets-tracker is excluded via .dockerignore and cannot be baked into the mcp Docker image by construction.
The mcp service lacks environment configuration (REBAR_TRACKER_DIR, MCP_TICKETS_PAT) and volume mounts that are present for the review-bot service.
Infrastructure provisioning scripts (compose-up.sh, fetch-secrets.sh, autodeploy.sh) do not provision or configure any tracker for the mcp service.
The mcp entrypoint must clone the tickets branch via a credential helper and converge the store on container startup, mirroring the review-bot implementation.
The ADR 0104-mcp-on-box.md does not document the ticket store provisioning decisions or the choice of full read-write access with a dedicated volume.
